text:
alex: Heads-up: we're going to roll out per-session KMS keys for the ap-southeast-1 GPU warm pool to meet the new audit retention and key-separation reqs. This changes the keystore auth flow and will increase keystore QPS during node joins. tagging @maria @kevin to triage.
maria: How big a QPS spike are we expecting? And any idea on node join latency hit?
kevin: Ballpark: ~2-3x read QPS during the first 8-12 minutes after a canary batch. Node join tail could add ~150-250ms if we don't cache session tokens. We can add a short-lived session cache (30s) on the join path to smooth it.
alex: Plan: staged canary. 5% of the warm pool in ap-southeast-1 first, then 20% after 30m if metrics stable. Monitor: keystore latency (p50/p95), auth errors, and audit log volume. Rollback if keystore p95 > 500ms or audit volume grows >20% above baseline. ops-bot: create canary monitors and a runbook link.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary created for keystore-per-session-ap-southeast-1. Alerts: keystore-qps, keystore-p95-latency, audit-ingest-rate. Notifying #oncall.
sre-oncall: We'll also need an egress rule change — KMS endpoints will be accessed via the keystore proxy in a different subnet. Need 443 outbound to keystore-subnet IPs or use privatelink. NAT GW could add cost and increase variability during spike.
maria: Good point. NATGW data processing for the canary could be non-trivial. Rough numbers: expected extra ~10TB/mo if we scale, roughly $800-1000/mo in NATGW egress processing. Privatelink endpoints cost ~300/mo + per-GB data fee but reduce NAT unpredictability.
kevin: Privatelink preferred for stable latency, but quota for interface endpoints in ap-southeast-1 is limited. We should check current endpoint usage and request quota bump if needed. Also consider session-terminating the keystore proxy so requests stay in-region and avoid cross-AZ egress charges.
lisa: Finance: please capture both scenarios in the infra spend forecast. If privatelink requires quota request lead time >2w, include a contingency for NATGW for the canary window.
alex: I'll draft a short runbook and perf/cost matrix in docs and link it. Quick alert snippet for the canary I'm adding to the runbook:

```
- alert: KeystoreP95High
  expr: keystore_request_duration_seconds{region="ap-southeast-1"} > 0.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Keystore p95 > 500ms in ap-southeast-1"
```
kevin: Sounds good. Starting the 5% canary now. Will post metrics in 15 min. If anyone sees auth errors >0.5% or audit ingestion rate > baseline*1.2 call for immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary kickoff at 6378001250. Monitoring: keystore-qps, keystore-p95, audit-ingest-rate, natgw-cost-estimate.
maria: I'll patch the join path with the 30s session cache and a feature flag so rollback is trivial.
alex: thanks all — keep updates in this thread and add any unexpected cost numbers.
